wicket because we felt it is a home game, it is going to stop a bit. When you were 
bowling slow, it was sticking. We were not good enough on the day. We will learn from it 
and move forward. Definitely lots of positives, early in the tournament, still figuring out 
lot of things for the team and hopefully it will come out nicely for us. 
Madhav: "And to think that PBKS still had the likes of Maxwell, Stoinis, Shashank, 
Suryansh and Jansen left to come after this" 
Shreyas Iyer, Punjab Kings captain: This is the start we required. Boys actually played 
their roles well, they contributed to the best of their ability, and whatever we planned, 
they executed it to the fullest. To be honest, there is no right combination. The 
camaraderie and synergy has to click at the right time. All teams have the potential to 
win the game, you just need to have a similar mindset of wanting to win - that is what 
we always talk about. I always try to be in the present and this innings is history for me, 
just want to focus on the next one now. 
Prabhsimran Singh, Player of the Match: (Message from Ricky Ponting and team 
management) They are legends, whenever they speak, it is always positive. There is no 
such thing as if (in his thinking). They ask us to go with just one mindset and that is of 
winning. They have asked us to back our game. Just have to try that if I get set, to finish 
off the game. (On the innovative shots he played) Have practiced a lot, and good that I 
could connect a few tonight. If a youngster gets off to a good start…this is a platform 
from where you can achieve your goal of playing for India. 
11pm That will be all from us for tonight. The Punjab Kings move level on points with 
the Delhi Capitals and Royal Challengers Bengaluru to become the early pace-setters. 
Speaking of RCB, they will have a chance tomorrow to go 3-0 when they take on the 
Gujarat Titans at the Chinnaswamy Stadium. Do join us for that game as well, and until 
then, this is goodbye from Chandan, Thilak and myself (Shashwat). Take care, folks!
